package spotify

// ddsonic composed stage (M3b2, plan v7): the harness. This file exists only
// in the overlay the SDK contract runner builds for its composed step
// (external/spotify/zz_ddsonic_composed_harness_test.go); go test ./... never
// compiles it. It runs the real ddsonic Session and provider over the real
// SDK constructor and player, with only remote services and the access point
// replaced by loopback fixtures (plan v7 §2):
//
//   - the router (§2.2), installed as http.DefaultTransport, with its exact
//     allowlist, lifecycle states and scoped expectations;
//   - F-HTTP, the fixture server behind it, and F-AP with the D10 observer
//     (§2.3, ap_composed_observer.go.txt);
//   - serial ownership with poison (§2.4);
//   - teardown T1-T10, the selectors Q, branch F with its checkpoint F1a,
//     the global-write rule and the happens-before set H (§2.5);
//   - the call-through observations D1-D5 and D11 (§2.7).
//
// Lines marked "MUTATION-POINT <name>" are where a control's named mutant
// changes this file (the mutant inputs are kept with the run logs).

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Errors the router answers with.

var (
	errComposedUnroutable = errors.New("composed router: request not on the allowlist")
	errComposedLateUse    = errors.New("composed router: closed: a late use")
	errComposedPoisoned   = errors.New("composed router: poisoned")
)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The router (plan v7 §2.2).

type routerState int32

const (
	routerOpen routerState = iota
	routerClosed
	routerPoisoned
)

func (s routerState) String() string {
	return [...]string{"open", "closed", "poisoned"}[s]
}

// composedRecord is one request as the router saw it.
type composedRecord struct {
	Seq    int64
	Method string
	Host   string
	Path   string
	Query  string
	Class  string // A1..A9, or "" when unmatched
	Phase  string
	Why    string // for a violation: unmatched, phase, 3xx
	Stack  string
	Time   time.Time
	CtxErr string // the request context's state at entry; "" when live (plan v9 §2.2)
	CtxID  string // the identity of the request's context
}

func (r composedRecord) String() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("#%d %s %s%s class=%q phase=%s why=%s ctx=%q", r.Seq, r.Method, r.Host, r.Path, r.Class, r.Phase, r.Why, r.CtxErr)
}

// composedAttempt is one call into the router, in any state: the attempt
// ledger the checked cut and the watches read (plan v9 §2.2, §2.5). An
// attempt is a transport call, never evidence of network I/O.
type composedAttempt struct {
	Seq       int64
	Host      string
	Path      string
	Range     string
	CtxErr    string // the request context's state at entry; "" when live
	CtxID     string // the identity of the request's context
	State     string // the router's state when it took the call
	Local     bool   // refused inside the router: never delegated
	Delegated bool
	Done      bool   // RoundTrip has returned
	Err       string // what RoundTrip returned
}

// composedTailGate is FC13's reader-tail gate (plan v9 §2.5): it parks, at
// RoundTrip entry and before the router's state is read, each attempt for
// its path whose context had ended at entry, until T5r (or F2) opens it.
type composedTailGate struct {
	path      string
	open      chan struct{}
	openOnce  sync.Once
	first     chan struct{}
	firstOnce sync.Once
	parked    atomic.Int32
}

func (g *composedTailGate) park() {
	g.parked.Add(1)
	g.firstOnce.Do(func() { close(g.first) })
	<-g.open
}

// FirstParked is closed when the gate parks its first attempt.
func (g *composedTailGate) FirstParked() <-chan struct{} { return g.first }

// composedDelegHold is FC14's router delegation hold (plan v9 §2.5): it
// parks a matching attempt after admission and before delegation.
type composedDelegHold struct {
	path, rng string
	parked    chan struct{}
	parkOnce  sync.Once
	release   chan struct{}
	relOnce   sync.Once
}

func (d *composedDelegHold) Parked() <-chan struct{} { return d.parked }
func (d *composedDelegHold) Release()                { d.relOnce.Do(func() { close(d.release) }) }

// composedDue is when a declared late use becomes due (plan v9 §2.2).
type composedDue int

const (
	dueT9    composedDue = iota // provoked before T9: checked exactly at T9
	dueFinal                    // provoked after the test's own teardown: checked by ZZ
)

// composedPattern names requests exactly: method, host and path, each
// either a literal or "*" for any.
type composedPattern struct{ Method, Host, Path string }

func (p composedPattern) matches(r composedRecord) bool {
	m := func(want, got string) bool { return want == "*" || want == got }
	return m(p.Method, r.Method) && m(p.Host, r.Host) && m(p.Path, r.Path)
}

func (p composedPattern) String() string { return p.Method + " " + p.Host + p.Path }

type composedRouter struct {
	name        string
	fixtureAddr string // the F-HTTP listener: the only address ever dialled
	transport   *http.Transport
	state       atomic.Int32 // a routerState; loaded by every RoundTrip

	mu           sync.Mutex
	seq          int64
	phase        string
	allowControl bool
	inFlight     int // client-side RoundTrips inside the router
	log          []composedRecord
	violations   []composedRecord
	lateUses     []composedRecord
	poisonUses   []composedRecord
	dials        []string
	counts       map[string]int // phase/class
	// declared late uses: the only late uses this router may record (ZZ,
	// over its whole life), and those due at T9 (plan v9 §2.2).
	declaredLate map[composedPattern]int
	dueLate      map[composedPattern]composedDue
	// attempts is every call into RoundTrip, in order (plan v9 §2.2).
	attempts []*composedAttempt
	// events is the harness's event log (FC5): who received which request.
	events func(string)

	tailGate  atomic.Pointer[composedTailGate]  // FC13 only
	delegHold atomic.Pointer[composedDelegHold] // FC14 only
}

func newComposedRouter(name, fixtureAddr string) *composedRouter {
	r := &composedRouter{name: name, fixtureAddr: fixtureAddr, phase: "P-H", counts: map[string]int{}, declaredLate: map[composedPattern]int{}, dueLate: map[composedPattern]composedDue{}}
	dialer := &net.Dialer{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}
	r.transport = &http.Transport{
		Proxy:             nil,
		ForceAttemptHTTP2: false,
		TLSClientConfig:   nil,
		DialContext: func(ctx context.Context, network, addr string) (net.Conn, error) {
			target := r.fixtureAddr // MUTATION-POINT FC4: target := addr
			r.mu.Lock()
			r.dials = append(r.dials, target)
			r.mu.Unlock()
			return dialer.DialContext(ctx, "tcp", target)
		},
		MaxIdleConnsPerHost: 16,
	}
	return r
}

var (
	reStorage = regexp.MustCompile(`^/storage-resolve/v2/files/audio/interactive/[0-9]+/[0-9a-f]{40}$`)
	reCDN     = regexp.MustCompile(`^/audio/[0-9a-f]{40}$`)
	reControl = regexp.MustCompile(`^/followup/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$`)
)

// classify is the exact allowlist: method + host + path (plan v7 §2.2).
func (r *composedRouter) classify(req *http.Request, allowControl bool) string {
	host, path, m := req.URL.Hostname(), req.URL.Path, req.Method
	switch host { // MUTATION-POINT FC2: host-only
	case "clienttoken.spotify.com":
		if m == "POST" && path == "/v1/clienttoken" {
			return "A1"
		}
	case "apresolve.spotify.com":
		q := req.URL.Query()
		if m == "GET" && (path == "/" || path == "") && len(q) == 1 && len(q["type"]) == 1 {
			switch q["type"][0] {
			case "accesspoint", "spclient", "dealer":
				return "A2"
			}
		}
	case "login5.spotify.com":
		if m == "POST" && path == "/v3/login" {
			return "A3"
		}
	case "spclient.composed.invalid":
		if m == "POST" && path == "/extended-metadata/v0/extended-metadata" {
			return "A4"
		}
		if m == "GET" && reStorage.MatchString(path) {
			return "A5"
		}
	case "cdn.composed.invalid":
		if m == "GET" && reCDN.MatchString(path) && req.Header.Get("Range") != "" {
			return "A6"
		}
	case "accounts.spotify.com":
		if m == "POST" && path == "/api/token" {
			return "A7"
		}
	case "api.spotify.com":
		return "A8"
	case "control.composed.invalid":
		if allowControl && m == "GET" && reControl.MatchString(path) {
			return "A9"
		}
	}
	return ""
}

// phaseForbids is the phase rule of plan v7 §3.2.
func phaseForbids(phase, class string) bool {
	switch phase {
	case "P1":
		return class == "A1" || class == "A2" || class == "A3" || class == "A7" || class == "A8"
	case "P2":
		return class == "A7" || class == "A8"
	}
	return false
}

func (r *composedRouter) RoundTrip(req *http.Request) (resp *http.Response, err error) {
	// The entry observation (plan v9 §2.2): the request context's state and
	// identity, read before anything else. For a C-cap client this is the
	// stream's own context (S/session.go:91-92).
	ctx := req.Context()
	rec := composedRecord{Method: req.Method, Host: req.URL.Hostname(), Path: req.URL.Path, Query: req.URL.RawQuery, Time: time.Now(), Stack: string(stackOfCaller()), CtxID: fmt.Sprintf("%p", ctx)}
	if e := ctx.Err(); e != nil {
		rec.CtxErr = e.Error()
	}
	att := &composedAttempt{Host: rec.Host, Path: rec.Path, Range: req.Header.Get("Range"), CtxErr: rec.CtxErr, CtxID: rec.CtxID}
	// FC13's reader-tail gate: before the router's state is read and before
	// admission (plan v9 §2.5).
	if g := r.tailGate.Load(); g != nil && rec.CtxErr != "" && att.Host == "cdn.composed.invalid" && att.Path == g.path {
		g.park()
	}
	switch routerState(r.state.Load()) {
	case routerClosed:
		r.mu.Lock()
		r.seq++
		rec.Seq, rec.Phase, rec.Why = r.seq, r.phase, "late use"
		att.Seq, att.State, att.Local, att.Done, att.Err = r.seq, "closed", true, true, errComposedLateUse.Error()
		r.lateUses = append(r.lateUses, rec)
		r.attempts = append(r.attempts, att)
		r.mu.Unlock()
		if r.events != nil {
			r.events("late-use:" + r.name)
		}
		return nil, errComposedLateUse
	case routerPoisoned:
		r.mu.Lock()
		r.seq++
		rec.Seq, rec.Phase, rec.Why = r.seq, r.phase, "poisoned"
		att.Seq, att.State, att.Local, att.Done, att.Err = r.seq, "poisoned", true, true, errComposedPoisoned.Error()
		r.poisonUses = append(r.poisonUses, rec)
		r.attempts = append(r.attempts, att)
		r.mu.Unlock()
		if r.events != nil {
			r.events("poison-use:" + rec.Host + rec.Path)
		}
		return nil, errComposedPoisoned
	}
	r.mu.Lock()
	r.inFlight++
	r.seq++
	rec.Seq, rec.Phase = r.seq, r.phase
	att.Seq, att.State = r.seq, "open"
	rec.Class = r.classify(req, r.allowControl)
	switch {
	case rec.Class == "":
		rec.Why = "unmatched"
	case phaseForbids(rec.Phase, rec.Class):
		rec.Why = "phase"
	}
	r.log = append(r.log, rec)
	if rec.Why != "" {
		r.violations = append(r.violations, rec)
		att.Local = true
	} else {
		r.counts[rec.Phase+"/"+rec.Class]++
	}
	r.attempts = append(r.attempts, att)
	r.mu.Unlock()
	defer func() {
		r.mu.Lock()
		r.inFlight--
		att.Done = true
		if err != nil {
			att.Err = err.Error()
		}
		r.mu.Unlock()
	}()
	if r.events != nil {
		r.events("router:" + rec.Host + rec.Path)
	}
	if rec.Why != "" {
		return nil, errComposedUnroutable // MUTATION-POINT FC1
	}
	// FC14's delegation hold: after admission, before delegation.
	if d := r.delegHold.Load(); d != nil && att.Path == d.path && att.Range == d.rng {
		d.parkOnce.Do(func() { close(d.parked) })
		<-d.release
	}
	out := req.Clone(req.Context()) // MUTATION-POINT FC13-MW
	out.URL.Scheme = "http"
	// The correlation of a receipt with its attempt: on the router's own
	// clone only; the request it received is not changed.
	out.Header.Set("X-Composed-Seq", strconv.FormatInt(rec.Seq, 10))
	r.mu.Lock()
	att.Delegated = true
	r.mu.Unlock()
	resp, err = r.transport.RoundTrip(out)
	if err == nil && resp.StatusCode >= 300 && resp.StatusCode < 400 { // MUTATION-POINT FC3
		r.mu.Lock()
		v := rec
		v.Why = "3xx"
		r.violations = append(r.violations, v)
		r.mu.Unlock()
	}
	return resp, err
}

// setState is the router's own, synchronized transition: no global is
// written (plan v7 §2.2, R25-1).
func (r *composedRouter) setState(s routerState) { r.state.Store(int32(s)) }

func (r *composedRouter) State() routerState { return routerState(r.state.Load()) }

// Seq is the last attempt ID the router allocated.
func (r *composedRouter) Seq() int64 {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	return r.seq
}

// Attempts is a snapshot of the attempt ledger.
func (r *composedRouter) Attempts() []composedAttempt {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	out := make([]composedAttempt, len(r.attempts))
	for i, a := range r.attempts {
		out[i] = *a
	}
	return out
}

// openTailGate opens FC13's reader-tail gate, if armed: at T5r's start, or
// at F2 when branch F comes first. It runs once.
func (r *composedRouter) openTailGate() {
	if g := r.tailGate.Load(); g != nil {
		g.openOnce.Do(func() { close(g.open) })
	}
}

func (r *composedRouter) SetPhase(p string) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	r.phase = p
	r.mu.Unlock()
}

// Count is how many allowlisted requests of class were routed in phase.
func (r *composedRouter) Count(phase, class string) int {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	return r.counts[phase+"/"+class]
}

// CountHost is how many requests the router saw for host, in any state.
func (r *composedRouter) CountHost(host string) int {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	n := 0
	for _, rec := range r.log {
		if rec.Host == host {
			n++
		}
	}
	return n
}

func (r *composedRouter) Violations() []composedRecord {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(r.violations)
}

func (r *composedRouter) LateUses() []composedRecord {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(r.lateUses)
}

func (r *composedRouter) PoisonUses() []composedRecord {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(r.poisonUses)
}

func (r *composedRouter) Dials() []string {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(r.dials)
}

func (r *composedRouter) Log() []composedRecord {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(r.log)
}

// waitIdle waits up to d for the router's client-side in-flight count to be
// zero. The count is read under the router's mutex, so a reader's earlier
// load of http.DefaultTransport is ordered before what follows (H).
func (r *composedRouter) waitIdle(d time.Duration) bool {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(d)
	for {
		r.mu.Lock()
		n := r.inFlight
		r.mu.Unlock()
		if n == 0 {
			return true
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			return false
		}
		time.Sleep(5 * time.Millisecond)
	}
}

// composedRouters is every router the process created, for ZZNoLateUse.
var (
	composedRoutersMu sync.Mutex
	composedRouters   []*composedRouter
)

func stackOfCaller() []byte {
	buf := make([]byte, 16<<10)
	return buf[:runtime.Stack(buf, false)]
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The tripwire: a previous transport that records and refuses.

type composedTripwire struct {
	calls atomic.Int32
	log   func(string)
}

func (w *composedTripwire) RoundTrip(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	w.calls.Add(1)
	if w.log != nil {
		w.log("tripwire:" + req.URL.Hostname() + req.URL.Path)
	}
	return nil, errors.New("composed tripwire: the previous transport was reached")
}

// composedRefuseAll is the transport X that FC12's M-T mutant assigns.
type composedRefuseAll struct {
	calls atomic.Int32
	log   func(string)
}

var errComposedRefusedByX = errors.New("composed refuse-all transport X")

func (x *composedRefuseAll) RoundTrip(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	x.calls.Add(1)
	if x.log != nil {
		x.log("X:" + req.URL.Hostname() + req.URL.Path)
	}
	return nil, errComposedRefusedByX
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The fixture catalog and F-HTTP (plan v7 §2.2, §6.2).

// The decryptor's base IV (T/audio/decryptor.go:16): the fixture encrypts
// with the same AES-128-CTR the player decrypts with.
var composedBaseIV = []byte{0x72, 0xe0, 0x67, 0xfb, 0xdd, 0xcb, 0xcf, 0x77, 0xeb, 0xe8, 0xbc, 0x64, 0x3f, 0x63, 0x0d, 0x93}

const composedChunk = 512 * 1024

type composedTrack struct {
	ID     librespot.SpotifyId
	FileID []byte
	Format metadatapb.AudioFile_Format
	Key    []byte
	Plain  []byte
	Enc    []byte
}

func (tr *composedTrack) URI() string     { return tr.ID.Uri() }
func (tr *composedTrack) FileHex() string { return hex.EncodeToString(tr.FileID) }
func (tr *composedTrack) Chunks() int     { return (len(tr.Enc) + composedChunk - 1) / composedChunk }

func composedEncrypt(key, plain []byte) []byte {
	block, err := aes.NewCipher(key)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	out := make([]byte, len(plain))
	cipher.NewCTR(block, composedBaseIV).XORKeyStream(out, plain)
	return out
}

func composedTrackFrom(n byte, format metadatapb.AudioFile_Format, plain []byte) *composedTrack {
	gid := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x5d, n}, 8)
	file := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xf1, n}, 10)
	key := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xa5, n}, 8)
	return &composedTrack{
		ID:     librespot.SpotifyIdFromGid(librespot.SpotifyIdTypeTrack, gid),
		FileID: file, Format: format, Key: key, Plain: plain, Enc: composedEncrypt(key, plain),
	}
}

// composedMP3Object builds the 6.5-chunk MP3 object of plan v7 §6.2 from
// tone.mp3.bin: its ID3v2 tag, then its audio frames (the LAME Info frame is
// left out, so that its frame count cannot end decoding early) repeated, and
// zero bytes to exactly 3,407,872 bytes.
func composedMP3Object() ([]byte, error) {
	src, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("testdata", "tone.mp3.bin"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(src) < 10 || string(src[:3]) != "ID3" {
		return nil, errors.New("tone.mp3.bin: no ID3v2 tag")
	}
	tag := 10 + (int(src[6])<<21 | int(src[7])<<14 | int(src[8])<<7 | int(src[9]))
	bitrates := map[uint32]int{1: 32, 2: 40, 3: 48, 4: 56, 5: 64, 6: 80, 7: 96, 8: 112, 9: 128, 10: 160, 11: 192, 12: 224, 13: 256, 14: 320}
	var frames [][]byte
	for i := tag; i+4 <= len(src); {
		h := binary.BigEndian.Uint32(src[i:])
		if h>>21 != 0x7ff || (h>>10)&3 != 0 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("tone.mp3.bin: no frame sync at %d", i)
		}
		size := 144000*bitrates[(h>>12)&0xf]/44100 + int((h>>9)&1)
		if size <= 4 || i+size > len(src) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("tone.mp3.bin: frame at %d of %d bytes", i, size)
		}
		frame := src[i : i+size]
		if !bytes.Contains(frame, []byte("Info")) && !bytes.Contains(frame, []byte("Xing")) {
			frames = append(frames, frame)
		}
		i += size
	}
	if len(frames) == 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("tone.mp3.bin: no audio frames")
	}
	const total = 6*composedChunk + composedChunk/2
	out := append([]byte(nil), src[:tag]...)
	for k := 0; ; k++ {
		f := frames[k%len(frames)]
		if len(out)+len(f) > total {
			break
		}
		out = append(out, f...)
	}
	out = append(out, make([]byte, total-len(out))...)
	return out, nil
}

// composedCDNRecord is one range request at the CDN.
type composedCDNRecord struct {
	File      string
	Chunk     int
	Arrived   time.Time
	CtxEnded  time.Time // zero if its context never ended while held
	Held      bool
	Status    int
	Completed time.Time
}

type composedHold struct {
	arrived    chan struct{}
	arriveOnce sync.Once // the arrival is announced once, whatever the number of handlers
	release    chan struct{}
	once       sync.Once // release, distinct from arrival
	ctxEnd     chan time.Time
	waiting    int // handlers held here now (under fx.mu)
	reached    int // handlers that have reached this hold (under fx.mu)
}

// arrive announces the hold's first arrival: an idempotent, synchronized
// operation for every handler that reaches it (R29-2).
func (h *composedHold) arrive(hook func(), key string) {
	h.arriveOnce.Do(func() { // MUTATION-POINT R29-2
		if hook != nil {
			hook()
		}
		close(h.arrived)
	})
}

// composedReceipt is one entry of F-HTTP's ordered receipt ledger (plan v9
// §2.2): a handler entered, which is the actual fixture I/O.
type composedReceipt struct {
	Pos      int    // the ledger position
	Seq      int64  // X-Composed-Seq: the carrying attempt's ID; -1 when absent or invalid
	SeqText  string // the header as received
	Host     string
	Path     string
	Range    string
	Arrived  time.Time
	Running  bool      // the handler has not returned
	WaitKey  string    // the hold the handler waits at now, or ""
	CtxEnded time.Time // when its server-side context ended before the handler returned
	Status   int
}

type composedReceiptKey struct{}

// composedStatusWriter records the status a handler wrote.
type composedStatusWriter struct {
	http.ResponseWriter
	status int
}

func (w *composedStatusWriter) WriteHeader(code int) {
	if w.status == 0 {
		w.status = code
	}
	w.ResponseWriter.WriteHeader(code)
}

func (w *composedStatusWriter) Write(p []byte) (int, error) {
	if w.status == 0 {
		w.status = http.StatusOK
	}
	return w.ResponseWriter.Write(p)
}

// Flush passes a handler's flush through (L5 (b)'s headers-then-body hold).
func (w *composedStatusWriter) Flush() {
	if f, ok := w.ResponseWriter.(http.Flusher); ok {
		f.Flush()
	}
}

// composedFixtures is F-HTTP: the fixture server the router dials.
type composedFixtures struct {
	ln  net.Listener
	srv *http.Server

	mu       sync.Mutex
	tracks   map[string]*composedTrack // by base62 id
	files    map[string]*composedTrack // by file hex
	holds    map[string]*composedHold  // "cdn/<file>/<chunk>", "metadata" or "control/<name>"
	ignore   map[string]bool           // holds that ignore their release (FC6)
	cdn      []composedCDNRecord
	ledger   []*composedReceipt // every handler entry, in order (plan v9 §2.2)
	handlers int
	// I4's controls: a status storage-resolve answers with, and one per CDN
	// file; 0 serves normally.
	storageStatus int
	cdnStatus     map[string]int
	events        func(string)
	served        sync.WaitGroup // Serve's goroutine
	// arriveHook, when a test sets it, runs inside a hold's first arrival
	// announcement (the shared-hold control).
	arriveHook func()
	// panics are the server's own reports of a handler panic: never a
	// mechanism result; T9 requires none.
	panics []string
	// I18's metadata controls (plan v9 §8; M3B2-S4 bundle, RB-2), default
	// off and set only by the row that selects them: metaStatus, when not 0,
	// is the HTTP status of every extended-metadata POST's response, after
	// the request's hold; restrict, by base62 id, makes a track's TRACK_V4
	// forbidden in the given countries, with an optional alternative.
	metaStatus int
	restrict   map[string]composedRestriction
}

// composedRestriction is one track's TRACK_V4 country restriction (RB-2):
// forbidden is a concatenation of two-letter country codes ("US", the
// country ddsonic gives the player), and alt, when not nil, is the one
// alternative served for it (itself added to the fixture, with its own file,
// key and CDN object).
type composedRestriction struct {
	forbidden string
	alt       *composedTrack
}

// composedPanicLog records net/http's own report of a handler panic.
type composedPanicLog struct{ fx *composedFixtures }

func (w composedPanicLog) Write(p []byte) (int, error) {
	w.fx.mu.Lock()
	w.fx.panics = append(w.fx.panics, string(p))
	w.fx.mu.Unlock()
	return len(p), nil
}

// Panics is every handler panic the server reported.
func (fx *composedFixtures) Panics() []string {
	fx.mu.Lock()
	defer fx.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(fx.panics)
}

// HoldCounts is how many handlers have reached the hold, and how many are
// held there now.
func (fx *composedFixtures) HoldCounts(key string) (reached, waiting int) {
	fx.mu.Lock()
	defer fx.mu.Unlock()
	if h := fx.holds[key]; h != nil {
		return h.reached, h.waiting
	}
	return 0, 0
}

func startComposedFixtures() (*composedFixtures, error) {
	ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	fx := &composedFixtures{ln: ln, tracks: map[string]*composedTrack{}, files: map[string]*composedTrack{}, holds: map[string]*composedHold{}, ignore: map[string]bool{}, cdnStatus: map[string]int{}}
	fx.srv = &http.Server{Handler: fx, ReadHeaderTimeout: 10 * time.Second}
	fx.srv.ErrorLog = log.New(composedPanicLog{fx}, "", 0)
	fx.served.Add(1)
	go func() {
		defer fx.served.Done()
		_ = fx.srv.Serve(ln)
	}()
	return fx, nil
}

func (fx *composedFixtures) Add(tr *composedTrack) {
	fx.mu.Lock()
	defer fx.mu.Unlock()
	fx.tracks[tr.ID.Base62()] = tr
	fx.files[tr.FileHex()] = tr
}

// Hold arms a hold on key; arrived is closed when a request reaches it.
// release lets it, and every later one, through.
func (fx *composedFixtures) Hold(key string) (arrived <-chan struct{}, release func()) {
	h := &composedHold{arrived: make(chan struct{}), release: make(chan struct{}), ctxEnd: make(chan time.Time, 1)}
	fx.mu.Lock()
	fx.holds[key] = h
	fx.mu.Unlock()
	return h.arrived, func() { h.once.Do(func() { close(h.release) }) }
}

// IgnoreRelease makes the hold on key ignore its release and its request's
// context: a handler that does not return until the process ends (FC6).
func (fx *composedFixtures) IgnoreRelease(key string) {
	fx.mu.Lock()
	fx.ignore[key] = true
	fx.mu.Unlock()
}

// HoldCtxEnded reports when the held request's context ended, if it did
// within d.
func (fx *composedFixtures) HoldCtxEnded(key string, d time.Duration) (time.Time, bool) {
	fx.mu.Lock()
	h := fx.holds[key]
	fx.mu.Unlock()
	if h == nil {
		return time.Time{}, false
	}
	select {
	case at := <-h.ctxEnd:
		h.ctxEnd <- at
		return at, true
	case <-time.After(d):
		return time.Time{}, false
	}
}

func (fx *composedFixtures) CDN() []composedCDNRecord {
	fx.mu.Lock()
	defer fx.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(fx.cdn)
}

// Ledger is a snapshot of the receipt ledger.
func (fx *composedFixtures) Ledger() []composedReceipt {
	fx.mu.Lock()
	defer fx.mu.Unlock()
	out := make([]composedReceipt, len(fx.ledger))
	for i, rc := range fx.ledger {
		out[i] = *rc
	}
	return out
}

// WaitingReceipt is the ledger position of the receipt waiting at the hold
// on key now.
func (fx *composedFixtures) WaitingReceipt(key string) (int, bool) {
	fx.mu.Lock()
	defer fx.mu.Unlock()
	for _, rc := range fx.ledger {
		if rc.Running && rc.WaitKey == key {
			return rc.Pos, true
		}
	}
	return -1, false
}

// AwaitCtxEnded waits up to d for the receipt at pos to record that its
// server-side context ended before its handler returned (W3).
func (fx *composedFixtures) AwaitCtxEnded(pos int, d time.Duration) bool {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(d)
	for {
		fx.mu.Lock()
		ended := pos >= 0 && pos < len(fx.ledger) && !fx.ledger[pos].CtxEnded.IsZero()
		fx.mu.Unlock()
		if ended {
			return true
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			return false
		}
		time.Sleep(5 * time.Millisecond)
	}
}

// receive appends a receipt to the ledger at handler entry (plan v9 §2.2).
func (fx *composedFixtures) receive(r *http.Request, host string) *composedReceipt {
	rc := &composedReceipt{Seq: -1, SeqText: r.Header.Get("X-Composed-Seq"), Host: host, Path: r.URL.Path, Range: r.Header.Get("Range"), Arrived: time.Now(), Running: true}
	if v, err := strconv.ParseInt(rc.SeqText, 10, 64); err == nil && v > 0 {
		rc.Seq = v
	}
	fx.mu.Lock()
	rc.Pos = len(fx.ledger)
	fx.ledger = append(fx.ledger, rc)
	fx.mu.Unlock()
	return rc
}

func (fx *composedFixtures) waitHandlersIdle(d time.Duration) bool {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(d)
	for {
		fx.mu.Lock()
		n := fx.handlers
		fx.mu.Unlock()
		if n == 0 {
			return true
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			return false
		}
		time.Sleep(5 * time.Millisecond)
	}
}

// wait holds a request at key, if a hold is armed there. It returns false
// when the request's context ended while held.
func (fx *composedFixtures) wait(key string, r *http.Request) bool {
	fx.mu.Lock()
	h, ignore, hook := fx.holds[key], fx.ignore[key], fx.arriveHook
	if h != nil {
		h.reached++
	}
	fx.mu.Unlock()
	if h == nil {
		return true
	}
	h.arrive(hook, key)
	if ignore {
		select {} // FC6: a handler that ignores its release; it ends with its process
	}
	rc, _ := r.Context().Value(composedReceiptKey{}).(*composedReceipt)
	fx.mu.Lock()
	h.waiting++
	if rc != nil {
		rc.WaitKey = key
	}
	fx.mu.Unlock()
	defer func() {
		fx.mu.Lock()
		h.waiting--
		if rc != nil {
			rc.WaitKey = ""
		}
		fx.mu.Unlock()
	}()
	select {
	case <-h.release:
		return r.Context().Err() == nil
	case <-r.Context().Done():
		at := time.Now()
		if rc != nil {
			fx.mu.Lock()
			rc.CtxEnded = at
			fx.mu.Unlock()
		}
		select {
		case h.ctxEnd <- at:
		default:
		}
		return false
	}
}

func (fx *composedFixtures) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	fx.mu.Lock()
	fx.handlers++
	fx.mu.Unlock()
	defer func() {
		fx.mu.Lock()
		fx.handlers--
		fx.mu.Unlock()
	}()
	host := r.Host
	if h, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(host); err == nil {
		host = h
	}
	// The receipt ledger (plan v9 §2.2): appended at handler entry.
	rc := fx.receive(r, host)
	r = r.WithContext(context.WithValue(r.Context(), composedReceiptKey{}, rc))
	sw := &composedStatusWriter{ResponseWriter: w}
	w = sw
	defer func() {
		ended := r.Context().Err() != nil
		fx.mu.Lock()
		rc.Running, rc.Status = false, sw.status
		if ended && rc.CtxEnded.IsZero() {
			rc.CtxEnded = time.Now()
		}
		fx.mu.Unlock()
	}()
	if fx.events != nil {
		fx.events("fixture:" + host + r.URL.Path)
	}
	switch host {
	case "clienttoken.spotify.com":
		fx.writeProto(w, &pbct.ClientTokenResponse{
			ResponseType: pbct.ClientTokenResponseType_RESPONSE_GRANTED_TOKEN_RESPONSE,
			Response: &pbct.ClientTokenResponse_GrantedToken{GrantedToken: &pbct.GrantedTokenResponse{
				Token: "composed-client-token", ExpiresAfterSeconds: 3600, RefreshAfterSeconds: 3600,
			}},
		})
	case "apresolve.spotify.com":
		var resp struct {
			Accesspoint []string `json:"accesspoint,omitempty"`
			Dealer      []string `json:"dealer,omitempty"`
			Spclient    []string `json:"spclient,omitempty"`
		}
		switch r.URL.Query().Get("type") {
		case "accesspoint":
			resp.Accesspoint = []string{composedAPAddr.Load().(string)}
		case "spclient":
			resp.Spclient = []string{"spclient.composed.invalid:443"}
		case "dealer":
			resp.Dealer = []string{"dealer.composed.invalid:443"}
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(resp)
	case "login5.spotify.com":
		fx.writeProto(w, &pblogin5.LoginResponse{Response: &pblogin5.LoginResponse_Ok{Ok: &pblogin5.LoginOk{
			Username: "ddsonic-composed", AccessToken: "composed-login5-token",
			StoredCredential: []byte("composed-stored"), AccessTokenExpiresIn: 3600,
		}}})
	case "spclient.composed.invalid":
		if r.URL.Path == "/extended-metadata/v0/extended-metadata" {
			// The request body is read before the hold: net/http starts the
			// background read that ends r.Context() on a client close only
			// once a request body is consumed, so a held POST with its body
			// unread could never see its context end. The hold is still
			// before any response header.
			body, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
			if err != nil {
				http.Error(w, err.Error(), 400)
				return
			}
			r.Body = io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(body))
			if !fx.wait("metadata", r) {
				return
			}
			fx.serveMetadata(w, r)
			return
		}
		fx.serveStorage(w, r)
	case "cdn.composed.invalid":
		fx.serveCDN(w, r)
	case "accounts.spotify.com":
		_ = r.ParseForm()
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
			"access_token": "composed-web-token", "token_type": "Bearer", "expires_in": 3600,
			"refresh_token": "composed-refresh", "scope": strings.Join(oauthScopes, " "),
		})
	case "control.composed.invalid":
		name := strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/followup/")
		if name == "redirect" {
			http.Redirect(w, r, "https://elsewhere.invalid/", http.StatusFound)
			return
		}
		if !fx.wait("control/"+name, r) {
			return
		}
		_, _ = io.WriteString(w, "ok")
	default:
		http.NotFound(w, r)
	}
}

func (fx *composedFixtures) writeProto(w http.ResponseWriter, m proto.Message) {
	data, err := proto.Marshal(m)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), 500)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/x-protobuf")
	_, _ = w.Write(data)
}

func (fx *composedFixtures) serveMetadata(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	// RB-2: a selected HTTP status for the POST itself (not an extension
	// header's StatusCode), snapshotted under the fixture's lock, which is
	// released before anything is written. 0 serves as before.
	fx.mu.Lock()
	status := fx.metaStatus
	fx.mu.Unlock()
	if status != 0 {
		w.WriteHeader(status)
		return
	}
	body, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), 400)
		return
	}
	var req extmetadatapb.BatchedEntityRequest
	if err := proto.Unmarshal(body, &req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), 400)
		return
	}
	resp := &extmetadatapb.BatchedExtensionResponse{}
	for _, er := range req.EntityRequest {
		id, err := librespot.SpotifyIdFromUri(er.EntityUri)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		fx.mu.Lock()
		tr := fx.tracks[id.Base62()]
		res, restricted := fx.restrict[id.Base62()]
		fx.mu.Unlock()
		if tr == nil {
			continue
		}
		for _, q := range er.Query {
			var m proto.Message
			switch q.ExtensionKind {
			case extmetadatapb.ExtensionKind_TRACK_V4:
				track := &metadatapb.Track{Gid: tr.ID.Id(), Name: proto.String("composed"), Duration: proto.Int32(60000)}
				if restricted { // RB-2; an unrestricted track is served as before
					track.Restriction = []*metadatapb.Restriction{{CountryRestriction: &metadatapb.Restriction_CountriesForbidden{CountriesForbidden: res.forbidden}}}
					if res.alt != nil {
						track.Alternative = []*metadatapb.Track{{Gid: res.alt.ID.Id()}}
					}
				}
				m = track
			case extmetadatapb.ExtensionKind_AUDIO_FILES:
				format := tr.Format
				m = &audiofilespb.AudioFilesExtensionResponse{Files: []*audiofilespb.ExtendedAudioFile{{File: &metadatapb.AudioFile{FileId: tr.FileID, Format: &format}}}}
			default:
				continue
			}
			a, err := anypb.New(m)
			if err != nil {
				continue
			}
			resp.ExtendedMetadata = append(resp.ExtendedMetadata, &extmetadatapb.EntityExtensionDataArray{
				ExtensionKind: q.ExtensionKind,
				ExtensionData: []*extmetadatapb.EntityExtensionData{{
					Header:        &extmetadatapb.EntityExtensionDataHeader{StatusCode: 200},
					EntityUri:     er.EntityUri,
					ExtensionData: a,
				}},
			})
		}
	}
	fx.writeProto(w, resp)
}

// SetStorageStatus makes storage-resolve answer with code (0: serve).
func (fx *composedFixtures) SetStorageStatus(code int) {
	fx.mu.Lock()
	fx.storageStatus = code
	fx.mu.Unlock()
}

// SetCDNStatus makes every range request for file answer with code (0:
// serve).
func (fx *composedFixtures) SetCDNStatus(file string, code int) {
	fx.mu.Lock()
	fx.cdnStatus[file] = code
	fx.mu.Unlock()
}

// SetMetadataStatus makes every extended-metadata POST answer with the HTTP
// status code after its hold (0: serve). RB-2, I18's metadata-error subject
// only.
func (fx *composedFixtures) SetMetadataStatus(code int) {
	fx.mu.Lock()
	fx.metaStatus = code
	fx.mu.Unlock()
}

// Restrict makes tr's TRACK_V4 forbidden in countries, with alt (nil: none)
// as its one alternative; alt must itself be added. RB-2, I18's restricted
// and relink subjects only.
func (fx *composedFixtures) Restrict(tr *composedTrack, countries string, alt *composedTrack) {
	fx.mu.Lock()
	if fx.restrict == nil {
		fx.restrict = map[string]composedRestriction{}
	}
	fx.restrict[tr.ID.Base62()] = composedRestriction{forbidden: countries, alt: alt}
	fx.mu.Unlock()
}

func (fx *composedFixtures) serveStorage(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	parts := strings.Split(r.URL.Path, "/")
	file := parts[len(parts)-1]
	// I4 (a): storage-resolve held after its receipt.
	if !fx.wait("storage", r) {
		return
	}
	fx.mu.Lock()
	tr, status := fx.files[file], fx.storageStatus
	fx.mu.Unlock()
	if status != 0 {
		http.Error(w, "composed storage-resolve control", status)
		return
	}
	if tr == nil {
		http.NotFound(w, r)
		return
	}
	fx.writeProto(w, &downloadpb.StorageResolveResponse{
		Result: downloadpb.StorageResolveResponse_CDN,
		Cdnurl: []string{"https://cdn.composed.invalid/audio/" + file},
		Fileid: tr.FileID,
	})
}

var reRange = regexp.MustCompile(`^bytes=(\d+)-(\d+)$`)

func (fx *composedFixtures) serveCDN(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	file := strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/audio/")
	fx.mu.Lock()
	tr := fx.files[file]
	fx.mu.Unlock()
	m := reRange.FindStringSubmatch(r.Header.Get("Range"))
	if tr == nil || m == nil {
		http.Error(w, "bad range", 416)
		return
	}
	start, _ := strconv.Atoi(m[1])
	end, _ := strconv.Atoi(m[2])
	chunk := start / composedChunk
	key := fmt.Sprintf("cdn/%s/%d", file, chunk)
	fx.mu.Lock()
	idx := len(fx.cdn)
	_, held := fx.holds[key]
	fx.cdn = append(fx.cdn, composedCDNRecord{File: file, Chunk: chunk, Arrived: time.Now(), Held: held})
	fx.mu.Unlock()
	if fx.events != nil {
		fx.events(fmt.Sprintf("cdn-arrived:%d", chunk))
	}
	if !fx.wait(key, r) {
		fx.mu.Lock()
		fx.cdn[idx].CtxEnded = time.Now()
		fx.mu.Unlock()
		return
	}
	fx.mu.Lock()
	status := fx.cdnStatus[file]
	fx.mu.Unlock()
	if status != 0 { // I4's A6 control
		http.Error(w, "composed CDN control", status)
		fx.mu.Lock()
		fx.cdn[idx].Status = status
		fx.mu.Unlock()
		return
	}
	if start >= len(tr.Enc) {
		http.Error(w, "range", 416)
		return
	}
	end = min(end, len(tr.Enc)-1)
	w.Header().Set("Content-Range", fmt.Sprintf("bytes %d-%d/%d", start, end, len(tr.Enc)))
	w.Header().Set("Content-Length", strconv.Itoa(end-start+1))
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusPartialContent)
	// L5 (b): headers sent, then the body held at "cdnbody/<file>/<chunk>".
	bodyKey := fmt.Sprintf("cdnbody/%s/%d", file, chunk)
	fx.mu.Lock()
	_, bodyHeld := fx.holds[bodyKey]
	fx.mu.Unlock()
	if bodyHeld {
		if f, ok := w.(http.Flusher); ok {
			f.Flush()
		}
		if !fx.wait(bodyKey, r) {
			fx.mu.Lock()
			fx.cdn[idx].CtxEnded = time.Now()
			fx.mu.Unlock()
			return
		}
	}
	_, err := w.Write(tr.Enc[start : end+1])
	fx.mu.Lock()
	fx.cdn[idx].Status = http.StatusPartialContent
	if err == nil {
		fx.cdn[idx].Completed = time.Now()
	}
	fx.mu.Unlock()
}

// composedAPAddr is F-AP's address, for apresolve's answer. It is written
// at install (W1), before any reader exists.
var composedAPAddr atomic.Value

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Serial ownership and poison (plan v7 §2.4).

type composedPoisonRecord struct {
	Test  string
	Joins string
	At    time.Time
}

type composedHolder struct {
	Test  string
	Since time.Time
}

var (
	composedSlot       = make(chan struct{}, 1)
	composedPoison     atomic.Pointer[composedPoisonRecord]
	composedPoisoned   = make(chan struct{})
	composedPoisonOnce sync.Once
	composedHeldBy     atomic.Pointer[composedHolder]
)

func composedPoisonErr(p *composedPoisonRecord) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("composed state poisoned by %s: %s", p.Test, p.Joins)
}

// tryAcquireComposed is acquireComposed's core: it returns the error
// instead of failing a test.
func tryAcquireComposed(test string, timeout time.Duration) error {
	if p := composedPoison.Load(); p != nil { // MUTATION-POINT FC6-precheck
		return composedPoisonErr(p)
	}
	select {
	case composedSlot <- struct{}{}:
		if p := composedPoison.Load(); p != nil {
			return composedPoisonErr(p) // defensive; the slot stays taken
		}
	case <-composedPoisoned: // MUTATION-POINT FC6-wake
		return composedPoisonErr(composedPoison.Load())
	case <-time.After(timeout):
		h := composedHeldBy.Load()
		if h == nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("composed state held for %v", timeout)
		}
		return fmt.Errorf("composed state held by %s for %v", h.Test, time.Since(h.Since).Round(time.Millisecond))
	}
	composedHeldBy.Store(&composedHolder{Test: test, Since: time.Now()})
	return nil
}

func acquireComposed(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	if err := tryAcquireComposed(t.Name(), 30*time.Second); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func releaseComposed() {
	composedHeldBy.Store(nil)
	<-composedSlot
}

// poisonComposed is F3: the record, the wake-up, and the slot kept.
func poisonComposed(test, joins string) {
	composedPoisonOnce.Do(func() {
		composedPoison.Store(&composedPoisonRecord{Test: test, Joins: joins, At: time.Now()})
		close(composedPoisoned)
	})
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The selectors Q (plan v7 §2.5).

type composedGoroutine struct {
	ID          int
	Header      string
	CreatorFunc string
	CreatorFile string
	Top         string
	Text        string
}

func (g composedGoroutine) String() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("goroutine %d [%s] top %s, created by %s at %s", g.ID, g.Header, g.Top, g.CreatorFunc, g.CreatorFile)
}

func composedGoroutines() []composedGoroutine {
	buf := make([]byte, 1<<20)
	for {
		n := runtime.Stack(buf, true)
		if n < len(buf) {
			buf = buf[:n]
			break
		}
		buf = make([]byte, 2*len(buf))
	}
	var gs []composedGoroutine
	for _, block := range strings.Split(string(buf), "\n\n") {
		lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(block), "\n")
		if len(lines) == 0 || !strings.HasPrefix(lines[0], "goroutine ") {
			continue
		}
		g := composedGoroutine{Text: block}
		head := strings.TrimPrefix(lines[0], "goroutine ")
		if sp := strings.IndexByte(head, ' '); sp > 0 {
			g.ID, _ = strconv.Atoi(head[:sp])
			g.Header = strings.Trim(head[sp+1:], "[]:")
		}
		if len(lines) > 1 {
			g.Top = lines[1]
		}
		for i, l := range lines {
			if strings.HasPrefix(l, "created by ") {
				f := strings.TrimPrefix(l, "created by ")
				if k := strings.Index(f, " in goroutine "); k >= 0 {
					f = f[:k]
				}
				g.CreatorFunc = f
				if i+1 < len(lines) {
					file := strings.TrimSpace(lines[i+1])
					if k := strings.LastIndex(file, ":"); k >= 0 {
						file = file[:k]
					}
					g.CreatorFile = file
				}
			}
		}
		gs = append(gs, g)
	}
	return gs
}

func currentGoroutineID() int {
	buf := make([]byte, 64)
	buf = buf[:runtime.Stack(buf, false)]
	f := strings.Fields(string(buf))
	if len(f) > 1 {
		id, _ := strconv.Atoi(f[1])
		return id
	}
	return -1
}

var composedQ2 = []string{"net/http.(*conn).serve(", "net/http.(*Server).Serve(", "net/http.(*persistConn).readLoop(", "net/http.(*persistConn).writeLoop("}

// inQ is the selector of plan v7 §2.5: Q1 by the creating go statement's
// package and file, Q2 by four named net/http frames.
func inQ(g composedGoroutine) bool {
	const sdk = "github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot/"
	const app = "github.com/bjarneo/cliamp/external/spotify."
	switch {
	case strings.HasPrefix(g.CreatorFunc, sdk):
		return true // the staged SDK, with H/ and D10
	case strings.HasPrefix(g.CreatorFunc, app):
		base := filepath.Base(g.CreatorFile)
		if !strings.HasSuffix(base, "_test.go") {
			return true // a non-test file of S/
		}
		return strings.HasPrefix(base, "zz_ddsonic_composed_") || base == "composed_bypass_ddsonic_test.go"
	}
	for _, f := range composedQ2 {
		if strings.Contains(g.Text, f) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// matchQ is every goroutine in Q but self.
func matchQ(self int) []composedGoroutine {
	var out []composedGoroutine
	for _, g := range composedGoroutines() {
		if g.ID != self && inQ(g) {
			out = append(out, g)
		}
	}
	return out
}

func waitQEmpty(self int, d time.Duration) []composedGoroutine {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(d)
	for {
		left := matchQ(self)
		if len(left) == 0 || time.Now().After(deadline) {
			return left
		}
		time.Sleep(20 * time.Millisecond)
	}
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The harness.

const composedJoin = 20 * time.Second

type composedD1Call struct {
	Phase string
	Start time.Time
	done  chan struct{}
	Sess  *session.Session
	Err   error
}

// Returned reports whether the call has returned (its channel is closed).
func (c *composedD1Call) Returned() bool {
	select {
	case <-c.done:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func (c *composedD1Call) WaitReturned(d time.Duration) bool {
	select {
	case <-c.done:
		return true
	case <-time.After(d):
		return false
	}
}

type composedOptions struct {
	// tripwire installs a recording tripwire as the previous transport,
	// before the router.
	tripwire bool
	// childControl permits the survivor group (FC12).
	childControl bool
	allowControl bool
	// joinBound overrides the 20 s join bound, for a child control only.
	joinBound time.Duration
}

// composedDecoder is a counted real decoder handed out by D3.
type composedDecoder struct {
	Format string
	closes func() int32
}

func (d *composedDecoder) Closes() int32 { return d.closes() }

type composedHarness struct {
	t      *testing.T
	opts   composedOptions
	self   int
	router *composedRouter
	fx     *composedFixtures
	ap     *ap.DDSonicComposedFake
	orig   http.RoundTripper // http.DefaultTransport before the test
	prev   http.RoundTripper // what T10 restores: orig, or the tripwire
	trip   *composedTripwire
	x      *composedRefuseAll

	restoreSeams []func()
	releases     []func()
	cancels      []context.CancelFunc
	closers      []io.Closer
	providers    []*SpotifyProvider
	sessions     []*Session

	calls     sync.WaitGroup
	callNames sync.Map
	survivors sync.WaitGroup
	survLive  atomic.Int32

	mu      sync.Mutex
	d1      []*composedD1Call
	d2      int
	d3      int
	d3wg    sync.WaitGroup
	d3ctx   []context.Context
	d3dec   []*composedDecoder
	d4      []uint64
	d5      int
	d11     int
	d11hold chan struct{}
	onOpen  func(point string) // D6: openHook's per-test barrier
	// onService runs, when a test sets it, as a bundle is serviced, before
	// the real servicing starts the access point's receive loop.
	onService func(b *playback)
	// onNewStream, when a test sets it, is D2's before-hold and returned
	// call-through observation and barrier (plan v9 §2.7, §3.3; M3B2-S4
	// bundle, RB-3); nil, the default, keeps D2 a counter only.
	onNewStream func(ev composedD2Event)
	// D6 (plan v9 §2.7): decisionHook, detachHook and beforeAccept, counted
	// per point and dispatched to the test's barrier when it sets one; and
	// closeLibrespot, counted per librespot session (L6, I5-O).
	decisions  map[string]int
	onDecision func(point string)
	detaches   map[string]int
	onDetach   func(point string)
	accepts    int
	onAccept   func(n int)
	closedLS   []*session.Session
	events     []string
	seq        int64

	expViol map[composedPattern]int

	// watches are the registered subject watches (plan v9 §2.5).
	watches []*composedWatch
	// t5rDone records that T5r ended within its bound (W4).
	t5rDone bool

	// checkpoint is branch F's F1a hook: nil except in FC12.
	checkpoint func(stage string)
	// teardown's result: "" or the failed step, and the branch taken.
	failedStep string
	branchF    bool
	t6done     bool
	reported   []composedGoroutine
}

// Event appends to the harness's event log under its mutex (FC5).
func (h *composedHarness) Event(name string) int64 {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	h.seq++
	h.events = append(h.events, fmt.Sprintf("%d:%s", h.seq, name))
	return h.seq
}

func (h *composedHarness) Events() []string {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(h.events)
}

// EventSeq is the sequence number of the first event with prefix, or 0.
func (h *composedHarness) EventSeq(prefix string) int64 {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	for _, e := range h.events {
		n, name, _ := strings.Cut(e, ":")
		if strings.HasPrefix(name, prefix) {
			v, _ := strconv.ParseInt(n, 10, 64)
			return v
		}
	}
	return 0
}

// Go tracks a test call; T5a joins it.
func (h *composedHarness) Go(name string, fn func()) {
	h.calls.Add(1)
	h.callNames.Store(name, true)
	go func() {
		defer h.calls.Done()
		defer h.callNames.Delete(name)
		fn()
	}()
}

// GoSurvivor tracks a goroutine a child control keeps alive through
// teardown (plan v7 §2.5, R26-1). T5 does not join it; it stays in Q; its
// presence at the end of T5 forces branch F.
func (h *composedHarness) GoSurvivor(name string, fn func()) {
	if !h.opts.childControl {
		h.t.Fatal("GoSurvivor is for a child control only")
	}
	h.survivors.Add(1)
	h.survLive.Add(1)
	go func() {
		defer h.survivors.Done()
		defer h.survLive.Add(-1)
		fn()
	}()
}

// JoinSurvivors waits up to d for the survivor group (the owning control's
// own bounded join).
func (h *composedHarness) JoinSurvivors(d time.Duration) bool {
	return waitGroupWithin(&h.survivors, d)
}

func waitGroupWithin(wg *sync.WaitGroup, d time.Duration) bool {
	done := make(chan struct{})
	go func() {
		wg.Wait()
		close(done)
	}()
	select {
	case <-done:
		return true
	case <-time.After(d):
		return false
	}
}

func (h *composedHarness) Context() (context.Context, context.CancelFunc) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	h.mu.Lock()
	h.cancels = append(h.cancels, cancel)
	h.mu.Unlock()
	return ctx, cancel
}

// OnRelease registers a barrier release for T1.
func (h *composedHarness) OnRelease(f func()) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	h.releases = append(h.releases, f)
	h.mu.Unlock()
}

func (h *composedHarness) KeepCloser(c io.Closer) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	h.closers = append(h.closers, c)
	h.mu.Unlock()
}

// Provider is a real provider over the dummy stored credential.
func (h *composedHarness) Provider() *SpotifyProvider {
	p := New(nil, composedClientID, 320)
	h.mu.Lock()
	h.providers = append(h.providers, p)
	h.mu.Unlock()
	return p
}

func (h *composedHarness) KeepSession(s *Session) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	h.sessions = append(h.sessions, s)
	h.mu.Unlock()
}

func (h *composedHarness) Phase(p string) { h.router.SetPhase(p) }

// OnOpen sets the test's barrier at openHook's named points (D6).
func (h *composedHarness) OnOpen(f func(point string)) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	h.onOpen = f
	h.mu.Unlock()
}

// composedD2Event is one D2 call-through point (RB-3): "before-hold", before
// the real Session.NewStream (so before holdPlayback), or "returned", after
// it returned, with what it returned. Attempt is D2's existing counter value
// for that call. The stream itself stays its caller's: only whether one was
// returned is reported.
type composedD2Event struct {
	Point   string
	Attempt int
	Err     error
	Stream  bool
}

// OnNewStream sets the test's D2 observation and barrier (nil clears it). f
// runs outside the harness's lock, on the calling goroutine, so a test may
// hold the call there; it must register its own T1 release.
func (h *composedHarness) OnNewStream(f func(ev composedD2Event)) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	h.onNewStream = f
	h.mu.Unlock()
}

// OnAccept sets the test's barrier at beforeAccept (nil clears it). The
// active stage's servicing, decision and detach barriers and counts are in
// the active adapter (composed_controls_test.go.txt).
func (h *composedHarness) OnAccept(f func(n int)) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	h.onAccept = f
	h.mu.Unlock()
}

// ClosedLibrespot reports whether the real closeLibrespot ran for sess.
func (h *composedHarness) ClosedLibrespot(sess *session.Session) bool {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Contains(h.closedLS, sess)
}

// Bundle is the provider's session and its current playback bundle, read
// under the session's lock.
func (h *composedHarness) Bundle(p *SpotifyProvider) (*Session, *playback) {
	s := p.sessionNow()
	if s == nil {
		return nil, nil
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	return s, s.play
}

// composedAPGoroutines counts the live access points' receive loops and pong
// tickers (the object-scoped baseline of plan v9 §6.2, L6).
func composedAPGoroutines() (recvLoops, tickers int) {
	for _, g := range composedGoroutines() {
		if strings.Contains(g.Text, "ap.(*Accesspoint).recvLoop(") {
			recvLoops++
		}
		if strings.Contains(g.Text, "ap.(*Accesspoint).pongAckTicker(") {
			tickers++
		}
	}
	return
}

func (h *composedHarness) ExpectViolation(p composedPattern, n int) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	h.expViol[p] += n
	h.mu.Unlock()
}

// ExpectLateUse declares late uses on this test's router, with when they
// become due (plan v9 §2.2): dueT9 ones are checked exactly at T9, and every
// declaration is checked exactly by ZZNoLateUse over the router's life.
func (h *composedHarness) ExpectLateUse(p composedPattern, n int, due composedDue) {
	h.router.mu.Lock()
	h.router.declaredLate[p] += n
	h.router.dueLate[p] = due
	h.router.mu.Unlock()
}

// ArmReaderTailGate arms FC13's reader-tail gate for file (plan v9 §2.5).
func (h *composedHarness) ArmReaderTailGate(file string) *composedTailGate {
	g := &composedTailGate{path: "/audio/" + file, open: make(chan struct{}), first: make(chan struct{})}
	h.router.tailGate.Store(g)
	return g
}

// HoldDelegation arms FC14's router delegation hold for file's range; T1
// releases it (plan v9 §2.5).
func (h *composedHarness) HoldDelegation(file, rng string) *composedDelegHold {
	d := &composedDelegHold{path: "/audio/" + file, rng: rng, parked: make(chan struct{}), release: make(chan struct{})}
	h.router.delegHold.Store(d)
	h.OnRelease(d.Release)
	return d
}

// composedCut is the checked subject cut (plan v9 §2.5).
type composedCut struct {
	File  string
	Path  string
	Seq0  int64  // the last attempt ID the router had allocated
	R0    int    // the receipt ledger's length: receipts after the cut are at R0 or later
	CtxID string // the subject stream's context identity
	Held  int    // the held receipt's ledger position, or -1
}

// composedWatch is a registered subject watch (plan v9 §2.5).
type composedWatch struct {
	composedCut
	Seq1         int64
	WantReceipts int  // 0, except FC14's declared exact count
	MinAttempts  int  // FC13's non-vacuity: attempts after the subject
	Boundary     bool // FC14: the counted receipts' attempt IDs are at or below Seq0
}

const composedCDNHost = "cdn.composed.invalid"

// tryCut is one attempt at the checked cut: in one critical section, the
// router's mutex then F-HTTP's (the only nested order), it checks (i)
// attribution, (ii) every earlier attempt accounted for and (iii) only the
// held work live, then records Seq0, R0 and the identity. checked = false is
// FC14's CutUnchecked.
func (h *composedHarness) tryCut(file string, held int, checked bool) (composedCut, error) {
	r, fx := h.router, h.fx
	path := "/audio/" + file
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	fx.mu.Lock()
	defer fx.mu.Unlock()
	c := composedCut{File: file, Path: path, Seq0: r.seq, R0: len(fx.ledger), Held: held}
	carrier := int64(-1)
	if held >= 0 {
		if held >= len(fx.ledger) {
			return c, fmt.Errorf("no receipt #%d", held)
		}
		rc := fx.ledger[held]
		if rc.Path != path || !rc.Running || rc.WaitKey == "" {
			return c, fmt.Errorf("the held receipt #%d is not waiting at a barrier for %s", held, path)
		}
		carrier = rc.Seq
	}
	for _, a := range r.attempts {
		if a.Host == composedCDNHost && a.Path == path && (carrier < 0 || a.Seq == carrier) {
			c.CtxID = a.CtxID
			break
		}
	}
	if !checked {
		return c, nil
	}
	received := map[int64]bool{}
	for _, rc := range fx.ledger {
		if rc.Seq > 0 {
			received[rc.Seq] = true
		}
	}
	for _, a := range r.attempts { // MUTATION-POINT FC14-MNA
		if a.Host != composedCDNHost || a.Path != path {
			continue
		}
		switch {
		case a.CtxID != c.CtxID:
			return c, fmt.Errorf("(i) attempt #%d carries another context identity: another stream has used the file", a.Seq)
		case !a.Local && !received[a.Seq]:
			return c, fmt.Errorf("(ii) attempt #%d was admitted and has no receipt", a.Seq)
		case !a.Done && a.Seq != carrier:
			return c, fmt.Errorf("(iii) attempt #%d is still inside RoundTrip", a.Seq)
		}
	}
	for _, rc := range fx.ledger {
		if rc.Path == path && rc.Running && rc.Pos != held {
			return c, fmt.Errorf("(iii) receipt #%d for the file is still running", rc.Pos)
		}
	}
	return c, nil
}

// Cut is the checked cut, retried for up to d with no hold released (plan
// v9 §2.5). Its bound exhausted is the row's STOP 9.
func (h *composedHarness) Cut(file string, held int, d time.Duration) (composedCut, error) {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(d)
	for {
		c, err := h.tryCut(file, held, true)
		if err == nil || time.Now().After(deadline) {
			return c, err
		}
		time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
	}
}

// TryCut is one attempt at the checked cut, without retrying (FC14).
func (h *composedHarness) TryCut(file string, held int) (composedCut, error) {
	return h.tryCut(file, held, true)
}

// CutUnchecked records a cut without its checks (FC14 only).
func (h *composedHarness) CutUnchecked(file string) composedCut {
	c, _ := h.tryCut(file, -1, false)
	return c
}

// Watch registers a watch on a cut, with Seq1 read now (after the subject
// action has returned).
func (h *composedHarness) Watch(c composedCut) *composedWatch {
	w := &composedWatch{composedCut: c, Seq1: h.router.Seq()}
	h.mu.Lock()
	h.watches = append(h.watches, w)
	h.mu.Unlock()
	return w
}

func (h *composedHarness) D1Calls() []*composedD1Call {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(h.d1)
}

func (h *composedHarness) Counts() (d1, d2, d3, d5, d11 int, d4 []uint64) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	return len(h.d1), h.d2, h.d3, h.d5, h.d11, slices.Clone(h.d4)
}

func (h *composedHarness) Decoders() []*composedDecoder {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(h.d3dec)
}

const composedClientID = "00000000000000000000000000c0ffee"

var composedDummyData = bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xd5}, 32)

const composedDeviceID = "c0ffeec0ffeec0ffeec0ffeec0ffeec0ffeec0ff"

// withComposed runs body in a composed scope: install, then the deferred
// teardown, on every exit (plan v7 §2.4-§2.5).
func withComposed(t *testing.T, opts composedOptions, body func(h *composedHarness)) *composedHarness {
	t.Helper()
	acquireComposed(t)
	h := &composedHarness{t: t, opts: opts, self: currentGoroutineID(), expViol: map[composedPattern]int{}}
	// Q at the start: nothing may already be running.
	if left := matchQ(h.self); len(left) != 0 {
		releaseComposed()
		t.Fatalf("composed: goroutines in Q before the test started (a failed earlier cleanup): %v", left)
	}
	h.install()
	func() {
		defer h.teardown()
		body(h)
	}()
	return h
}

func (h *composedHarness) bound() time.Duration {
	if h.opts.joinBound > 0 {
		return h.opts.joinBound
	}
	return composedJoin
}

func (h *composedHarness) install() {
	t := h.t
	var err error
	if h.ap, err = ap.DDSonicComposedStart(); err != nil {
		releaseComposed()
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if h.fx, err = startComposedFixtures(); err != nil {
		h.ap.Stop()
		h.ap.Restore()
		releaseComposed()
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	h.fx.events = func(s string) { h.Event(s) }
	composedAPAddr.Store(h.ap.Addr())
	// W1: the shared globals are written here, before any reader of this
	// test exists.
	h.orig = http.DefaultTransport
	h.prev = h.orig
	if h.opts.tripwire {
		h.trip = &composedTripwire{log: func(s string) { h.Event(s) }}
		http.DefaultTransport = h.trip
		h.prev = h.trip
	}
	h.router = newComposedRouter(t.Name(), h.fx.ln.Addr().String())
	h.router.allowControl = h.opts.allowControl
	h.router.events = func(s string) { h.Event(s) }
	composedRoutersMu.Lock()
	composedRouters = append(composedRouters, h.router)
	composedRoutersMu.Unlock()
	http.DefaultTransport = h.router
	h.installSeams()
	if err := saveCreds(&storedCreds{Username: "ddsonic-composed", Data: composedDummyData, DeviceID: composedDeviceID, RefreshToken: "composed-refresh"}); err != nil {
		t.Errorf("composed: dummy credentials: %v", err)
	}
}

// RestoreOriginal puts the test's original transport back after a test
// that installed a tripwire as the previous transport has finished with it.
// It does nothing in a poisoned process.
func (h *composedHarness) RestoreOriginal() {
	if composedPoison.Load() == nil && h.trip != nil && http.DefaultTransport == h.trip {
		http.DefaultTransport = h.orig
	}
}

// installSeams sets D1-D5 and D11: call-throughs and counters only.
func (h *composedHarness) installSeams() {
	origNew, origNS, origPNS, origRec, origInter, origInit, origOpen := newLibrespotSession, sessionNewStream, playerNewStream, sessionReconnect, interactiveTokens, initSessionPlayer, openHook
	h.restoreSeams = append(h.restoreSeams, func() {
		newLibrespotSession, sessionNewStream, playerNewStream, sessionReconnect, interactiveTokens, initSessionPlayer, openHook = origNew, origNS, origPNS, origRec, origInter, origInit, origOpen
	})
	origAccept, origCloseLS := beforeAccept, closeLibrespot
	h.restoreSeams = append(h.restoreSeams, func() {
		beforeAccept, closeLibrespot = origAccept, origCloseLS
	})
	// The stage's own decision and detach points (the active adapter: D6's
	// decisionHook and detachHook, and recoveryTimeout's save/restore; the
	// stock adapter: none, rc.4 has no such seams).
	h.installStageRecoveryHooks()
	beforeAccept = func() {
		h.mu.Lock()
		h.accepts++
		n, f := h.accepts, h.onAccept
		h.mu.Unlock()
		if f != nil {
			f(n)
		}
	}
	// closeLibrespot: a call-through, counted per librespot session.
	closeLibrespot = func(p *librespotPlayer.Player, sess *session.Session) {
		h.mu.Lock()
		h.closedLS = append(h.closedLS, sess)
		h.mu.Unlock()
		origCloseLS(p, sess)
	}
	// The stage's own servicing seam (the active adapter: serviceAccessPoint's
	// call-through; the stock adapter: none, rc.4 has no such seam).
	h.installStageService()
	// D6: openHook, dispatched to the test's barrier when it sets one.
	openHook = func(point string) {
		h.Event("open:" + point)
		h.mu.Lock()
		f := h.onOpen
		h.mu.Unlock()
		if f != nil {
			f(point)
		}
	}
	// D1: the bypass, counted, refused unless the router is installed and
	// open; each call's return is announced on its own channel (H).
	newLibrespotSession = func(ctx context.Context, opts *session.Options) (*session.Session, error) {
		if http.DefaultTransport != h.router || h.router.State() != routerOpen {
			return nil, errors.New("composed bypass: the router is not installed and open")
		}
		call := &composedD1Call{Start: time.Now(), done: make(chan struct{})}
		h.router.mu.Lock()
		call.Phase = h.router.phase
		h.router.mu.Unlock()
		h.mu.Lock()
		h.d1 = append(h.d1, call)
		h.mu.Unlock()
		h.Event("d1-start")
		sess, err := composedLibrespotSession(ctx, opts)
		call.Sess, call.Err = sess, err
		close(call.done)
		h.Event("d1-return")
		return sess, err
	}
	// D2, with RB-3's default-off before-hold and returned call-through
	// points: one real call with the same arguments and results; the
	// counter moves where it did; the test's function runs outside h.mu.
	sessionNewStream = func(s *Session, ctx context.Context, id librespot.SpotifyId, bitrate int) (*librespotPlayer.Stream, context.CancelFunc, error) {
		h.mu.Lock()
		h.d2++
		n, f := h.d2, h.onNewStream
		h.mu.Unlock()
		if f == nil {
			return origNS(s, ctx, id, bitrate)
		}
		f(composedD2Event{Point: "before-hold", Attempt: n})
		stream, cancel, err := origNS(s, ctx, id, bitrate)
		f(composedD2Event{Point: "returned", Attempt: n, Err: err, Stream: stream != nil})
		return stream, cancel, err
	}
	// D3: real Player.NewStream starts, the setup context, the in-flight
	// count, and real MP3/FLAC decoders wrapped in a Close counter.
	playerNewStream = func(b *playback, ctx context.Context, client *http.Client, id librespot.SpotifyId, bitrate int) (*librespotPlayer.Stream, error) {
		h.d3wg.Add(1)
		defer h.d3wg.Done()
		h.mu.Lock()
		h.d3++
		h.d3ctx = append(h.d3ctx, ctx)
		h.mu.Unlock()
		stream, err := origPNS(b, ctx, client, id, bitrate)
		if err == nil && stream != nil {
			switch d := stream.Source.(type) {
			case *mp3.Decoder:
				c := &countedMP3{Decoder: d}
				stream.Source = c
				h.mu.Lock()
				h.d3dec = append(h.d3dec, &composedDecoder{Format: "mp3", closes: c.closes.Load})
				h.mu.Unlock()
			case *flac.Decoder:
				c := &countedFLAC{Decoder: d}
				stream.Source = c
				h.mu.Lock()
				h.d3dec = append(h.d3dec, &composedDecoder{Format: "flac", closes: c.closes.Load})
				h.mu.Unlock()
			}
		}
		return stream, err
	}
	// D4.
	sessionReconnect = func(s *Session, ctx context.Context, gen uint64) error {
		h.mu.Lock()
		h.d4 = append(h.d4, gen)
		h.mu.Unlock()
		return origRec(s, ctx, gen)
	}
	// D5: counted; still refuses.
	interactiveTokens = func(ctx context.Context, flows []oauthFlow) ([]*oauth2.Token, error) {
		h.mu.Lock()
		h.d5++
		h.mu.Unlock()
		return origInter(ctx, flows)
	}
	// D11: counted, and held when a test arms it.
	initSessionPlayer = func(s *Session) error {
		h.mu.Lock()
		h.d11++
		hold := h.d11hold
		h.mu.Unlock()
		if hold != nil {
			<-hold
		}
		return origInit(s)
	}
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Teardown (plan v7 §2.5).

func (h *composedHarness) teardown() {
	if p := recover(); p != nil {
		h.teardownSteps()
		panic(p)
	}
	h.teardownSteps()
}

func (h *composedHarness) fail(step string) {
	if h.failedStep == "" {
		h.failedStep = step
	}
}

func (h *composedHarness) teardownSteps() {
	t := h.t
	bound := h.bound()
	// T1: release every barrier, idempotently.
	h.mu.Lock()
	releases := slices.Clone(h.releases)
	if h.d11hold != nil {
		close(h.d11hold)
		h.d11hold = nil
	}
	h.mu.Unlock()
	for _, f := range releases {
		f()
	}
	// T2: cancel every test-owned context.
	h.mu.Lock()
	cancels := slices.Clone(h.cancels)
	closers := slices.Clone(h.closers)
	providers := slices.Clone(h.providers)
	sessions := slices.Clone(h.sessions)
	h.mu.Unlock()
	for _, c := range cancels {
		c()
	}
	// T3: close every accepted streamer the test still holds.
	for _, c := range closers {
		_ = c.Close()
	}
	// T4: close the provider(s) and Session(s): the real Close, retireNow and
	// closeLibrespot.
	for _, p := range providers {
		p.Close()
	}
	for _, s := range sessions {
		s.Close()
	}
	// T5: join the users, in order, each bounded.
	switch {
	case !waitGroupWithin(&h.calls, bound):
		h.fail("T5a (the test's tracked calls)")
	case !waitGroupWithin(&builds, bound):
		h.fail("T5b (builds)")
	case !waitGroupWithin(&tails, bound):
		h.fail("T5c (tails)")
	case !waitGroupWithin(&h.d3wg, bound):
		h.fail("T5d (D3 in-flight playerNewStream)")
	case !h.drainReaderTails(composedReaderTailBound): // MUTATION-POINT FC13-MR5
		h.fail("T5r (reader tails)")
	case !h.router.waitIdle(bound):
		h.fail("T5e (router in-flight)")
	case h.survLive.Load() > 0:
		h.fail("T5 (a survivor is live)")
	}
	if h.failedStep != "" {
		h.branchFRun()
		return
	}
	// T6: stop the fixtures; nothing is restored here.
	h.stopFixtures()
	// T6-AFTER (FC13's M-R5 moves T5r here)
	// T7: join the stopped fixture workers.
	switch {
	case !h.ap.JoinWorkers(bound):
		h.fail("T7 (F-AP observer workers)")
	case !waitGroupWithin(&h.fx.served, bound):
		h.fail("T7 (F-HTTP Serve)")
	case !h.fx.waitHandlersIdle(bound):
		h.fail("T7 (F-HTTP handlers)")
	}
	// T8: quiescence.
	if h.failedStep == "" {
		if left := waitQEmpty(h.self, bound); len(left) != 0 {
			h.reported = left
			h.fail("T8 (quiescence)")
		}
	}
	if h.failedStep != "" {
		h.branchFRun()
		return
	}
	// T9: the declared scope, exactly.
	h.checkScope()
	// T10: H, then W2, then the slot.
	if err := h.establishH(); err != nil {
		h.fail("T10 (H: " + err.Error() + ")")
		h.branchFRun()
		return
	}
	for i := len(h.restoreSeams) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		h.restoreSeams[i]()
	}
	http.DefaultTransport = h.prev // W2
	h.ap.Restore()
	h.Event("restore")
	releaseComposed()
	if h.trip == nil && http.DefaultTransport != h.orig {
		t.Error("composed: http.DefaultTransport was not restored")
	}
}

func (h *composedHarness) stopFixtures() {
	if h.t6done {
		return
	}
	h.t6done = true
	_ = h.fx.srv.Close()
	h.router.transport.CloseIdleConnections()
	if !h.branchF {
		h.router.setState(routerClosed)
	}
	h.ap.Stop()
}

// establishH is the happens-before set H (plan v7 §2.5): every possible
// reader has finished, synchronized through a primitive the harness also
// uses. The waits on calls, builds, tails, D3 and the router were T5's.
func (h *composedHarness) establishH() error {
	for i, c := range h.D1Calls() {
		if !c.WaitReturned(time.Second) {
			return fmt.Errorf("D1 call %d has not returned", i)
		}
		if c.Sess != nil {
			a := c.Sess.Accesspoint()
			if !ap.DDSonicComposedAPDone(a) {
				return fmt.Errorf("D1 call %d: its access point is not done", i)
			}
			ap.DDSonicComposedConnMuSync(a)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// checkScope is T9: violations equal the declaration exactly; no handler
// panicked; every authenticated connection was drained by D10.
func (h *composedHarness) checkScope() {
	t := h.t
	if p := h.fx.Panics(); len(p) != 0 {
		t.Errorf("T9: a fixture handler panicked: %v", p)
	}
	drained, logins := h.ap.Drained(), h.ap.Logins()
	occ, capacity := h.ap.Occupancy()
	if drained != logins || occ > capacity {
		t.Errorf("T9: D10: every authenticated connection drained: drained %d, logins %d; observed conns occupancy at most %d of capacity %d", drained, logins, occ, capacity)
	}
	h.mu.Lock()
	want := map[composedPattern]int{}
	for k, v := range h.expViol {
		want[k] = v
	}
	h.mu.Unlock()
	got := map[composedPattern]int{}
	var unmatched []composedRecord
	for _, v := range h.router.Violations() {
		found := false
		for p := range want {
			if p.matches(v) {
				got[p]++
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			unmatched = append(unmatched, v)
		}
	}
	for p, n := range want {
		if got[p] != n {
			t.Errorf("T9: declared %d violation(s) of %v, recorded %d", n, p, got[p])
		}
	}
	if len(unmatched) != 0 {
		t.Errorf("T9: undeclared violations: %v", unmatched)
	}
	h.checkLateDue()
	h.checkReceipts()
}

// composedReaderTailBound is T5r's bound: a controlled-test bound, not a
// production bound on the reader's surviving work (plan v9 §2.5, §11).
const composedReaderTailBound = 120 * time.Second

// drainReaderTails is T5r (plan v9 §2.5): with F-HTTP, the open router and
// F-AP live, it opens FC13's reader-tail gate if armed, then waits for every
// SDK reader prefetch worker to end. After T5a-T5d nothing can create one,
// so their absence, once observed, is stable; it is not an H edge.
func (h *composedHarness) drainReaderTails(d time.Duration) bool {
	start, seq0 := time.Now(), h.router.Seq()
	h.router.openTailGate()
	waited := false
	for {
		left := 0
		for _, g := range composedGoroutines() {
			if strings.Contains(g.CreatorFunc, "(*HttpChunkedReader).startPrefetch") {
				left++
			}
		}
		if left == 0 {
			h.t5rDone = true
			if waited || h.router.tailGate.Load() != nil {
				h.t.Logf("COMPOSED-READER-TAIL %v %d", time.Since(start).Round(time.Millisecond), h.router.Seq()-seq0)
			}
			return true
		}
		if time.Since(start) > d {
			return false
		}
		waited = true
		time.Sleep(20 * time.Millisecond)
	}
}

// checkLateDue is T9's late-use check (plan v9 §2.2): the late uses recorded
// so far equal the dueT9 declarations exactly, and none matches a dueFinal
// pattern yet. ZZNoLateUse checks every declaration over the router's life.
func (h *composedHarness) checkLateDue() {
	r := h.router
	r.mu.Lock()
	decl := map[composedPattern]int{}
	due := map[composedPattern]composedDue{}
	for p, n := range r.declaredLate {
		decl[p], due[p] = n, r.dueLate[p]
	}
	late := slices.Clone(r.lateUses)
	r.mu.Unlock()
	want, got := map[composedPattern]int{}, map[composedPattern]int{}
	for p, n := range decl {
		if due[p] == dueT9 {
			want[p] = n
		}
	}
	var undeclared, early []string
	for _, l := range late {
		matched := false
		for p := range decl {
			if p.matches(l) {
				matched = true
				if due[p] == dueFinal {
					early = append(early, l.String())
				} else {
					got[p]++
				}
				break
			}
		}
		if !matched {
			undeclared = append(undeclared, l.String())
		}
	}
	bad := len(undeclared) != 0 || len(early) != 0
	for p, n := range want {
		if got[p] != n {
			bad = true
		}
	}
	if bad {
		h.t.Errorf("T9: late uses due at T9 equal the dueT9 declarations %v: recorded %v; undeclared %v; early (due final) %v", want, got, undeclared, early)
	}
}

// checkReceipts is T9's receipt check (plan v9 §2.2, §2.5): every receipt
// correlates with an attempt the router delegated (fail closed), and every
// watch's W1-W4.
func (h *composedHarness) checkReceipts() {
	t := h.t
	atts, led := h.router.Attempts(), h.fx.Ledger()
	issued := map[int64]bool{}
	for _, a := range atts {
		if a.Delegated {
			issued[a.Seq] = true
		}
	}
	for _, rc := range led {
		if rc.Seq <= 0 || !issued[rc.Seq] {
			t.Errorf("T9: an uncorrelated receipt (fail closed): #%d %s%s X-Composed-Seq %q", rc.Pos, rc.Host, rc.Path, rc.SeqText)
		}
	}
	h.mu.Lock()
	ws := slices.Clone(h.watches)
	h.mu.Unlock()
	for _, w := range ws {
		var n, ended, late, after int
		for _, a := range atts {
			if a.Host != composedCDNHost || a.Path != w.Path || a.Seq <= w.Seq0 {
				continue
			}
			n++
			if a.CtxErr != "" {
				ended++
			}
			if a.State == "closed" {
				late++
			}
			if a.CtxID != w.CtxID {
				t.Errorf("T9: watch %s: W1: attempt #%d carries another context identity (broken attribution)", w.File, a.Seq)
			}
			if a.Seq > w.Seq1 {
				after++
				if a.CtxErr == "" {
					t.Errorf("T9: watch %s: W1: attempt #%d after the subject had a live context at entry", w.File, a.Seq)
				}
			}
		}
		var ids []int64
		for _, rc := range led {
			if rc.Pos >= w.R0 && rc.Host == composedCDNHost && rc.Path == w.Path { // MUTATION-POINT FC14-MID
				ids = append(ids, rc.Seq)
			}
		}
		t.Logf("COMPOSED-WATCH file=%s attempts=%d ended-at-entry=%d late=%d receipts=%d", w.File, n, ended, late, len(ids))
		if w.MinAttempts > 0 && after < w.MinAttempts {
			t.Errorf("T9: watch %s: W1: at least %d attempt(s) after the subject (the surviving work exercised), recorded %d", w.File, w.MinAttempts, after)
		}
		if w.Boundary {
			ok := len(ids) == w.WantReceipts
			for _, id := range ids {
				if id > w.Seq0 {
					ok = false
				}
			}
			if !ok {
				t.Errorf("T9: watch %s: (2) W2 equals the declared %d: the receipt admitted before the cut and received after it: recorded %d after the cut, attempt IDs %v, seq0 %d", w.File, w.WantReceipts, len(ids), ids, w.Seq0)
			}
		} else if len(ids) != w.WantReceipts {
			t.Errorf("T9: watch %s: no CDN receipt for the watched file after the cut: recorded %d (attempt IDs %v)", w.File, len(ids), ids)
		}
		if w.Held >= 0 && (w.Held >= len(led) || led[w.Held].CtxEnded.IsZero()) {
			t.Errorf("T9: watch %s: W3: the held request's server-side context did not end before its handler returned", w.File)
		}
		if !h.t5rDone {
			t.Errorf("T9: watch %s: W4: T5r did not end", w.File)
		}
	}
}

// branchFRun is branch F (plan v7 §2.5, R25-1, R26-1): nothing a survivor
// can read is written.
func (h *composedHarness) branchFRun() {
	t := h.t
	h.branchF = true
	// F1: the router's own state. No global is assigned.
	h.router.setState(routerPoisoned) // MUTATION-POINT FC12-MT
	// F1a: the checkpoint (FC12 only).
	if h.checkpoint != nil {
		h.checkpoint("after-F1")
	}
	// F2: stop the fixtures, without restoring anything; FC13's reader-tail
	// gate, if T5r has not opened it, opens here (plan v9 §2.5).
	h.stopFixtures()
	h.router.openTailGate()
	// F3: poison; the slot is kept.
	var names []string
	h.callNames.Range(func(k, _ any) bool {
		names = append(names, k.(string))
		return true
	})
	slices.Sort(names)
	poisonComposed(t.Name(), h.failedStep)
	// F4: still join and evaluate Q, to report.
	bound := h.bound()
	_ = h.ap.JoinWorkers(bound)
	_ = h.fx.waitHandlersIdle(bound / 4)
	left := waitQEmpty(h.self, bound/4)
	h.reported = left
	// F5: fail, naming the step and the live workers.
	var live []string
	for _, g := range left {
		live = append(live, g.String())
	}
	t.Errorf("composed cleanup failed at %s; branch F: router %v, fixtures stopped, nothing restored, slot kept; tracked calls still live: %v; live workers (%d):\n%s",
		h.failedStep, h.router.State(), names, len(left), strings.Join(live, "\n"))
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Small helpers for the tests.

// nonSilent reports whether samples hold a signal.
func nonSilent(samples [][2]float64) bool {
	var sum float64
	for _, s := range samples {
		sum += s[0]*s[0] + s[1]*s[1]
	}
	return len(samples) > 0 && math.Sqrt(sum/float64(2*len(samples))) > 1e-3
}

// composedWithin waits for ch up to d.
func composedWithin[T any](ch <-chan T, d time.Duration) (T, bool) {
	var zero T
	select {
	case v := <-ch:
		return v, true
	case <-time.After(d):
		return zero, false
	}
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Shared fixture helpers (M3B2-S3 split): moved byte-identically from the
// controls and cases overlays, so the stock stage shares them.

// composedMP3Track is the 6.5-chunk MP3 fixture as a track.
func composedMP3Track(t *testing.T, n byte) *composedTrack {
	t.Helper()
	plain, err := composedMP3Object()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return composedTrackFrom(n, metadatapb.AudioFile_MP3_320, plain)
}

// answerKeys answers every key request with the fixture's key.
func answerKeys(h *composedHarness, tr *composedTrack) {
	h.ap.SetAutoKey(func(ap.Packet) []byte { return tr.Key })
}

type composedOpen struct {
	s   beep.StreamSeekCloser
	err error
	at  time.Time
}

// readSamples reads n samples from s, in blocks, and returns the last block.
func readSamples(t *testing.T, s beep.Streamer, n int) [][2]float64 {
	t.Helper()
	buf := make([][2]float64, 4096)
	var last [][2]float64
	for read := 0; read < n; {
		k, ok := s.Stream(buf)
		if k == 0 && !ok {
			t.Fatalf("the stream ended after %d of %d samples", read, n)
		}
		read += k
		last = append(last[:0], buf[:k]...)
	}
	return last
}

// composedOpenAsync starts an E-outer play through the real provider, tracked.
func composedOpenAsync(h *composedHarness, name string, p *SpotifyProvider, uri string) <-chan composedOpen {
	out := make(chan composedOpen, 1)
	h.Go(name, func() {
		s, _, _, err := p.NewStreamer(uri)
		out <- composedOpen{s, err, time.Now()}
	})
	return out
}

// composedKeyWrites is how many key requests the client sent on the i-th
// authenticated connection, or -1 when there is none.
func composedKeyWrites(h *composedHarness, i int) int {
	c := h.ap.Conn(i, 0)
	if c == nil {
		return -1
	}
	return c.Count(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey)
}

// composedAPDoneOf reports whether b's access point is Done.
func composedAPDoneOf(b *playback) bool { return ap.DDSonicComposedAPDone(b.sess.Accesspoint()) }
